description: Presidential Secretariat - Subject & Functions of the State Minister of Renewable Energy & Power
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Gotabaya Rajapaksa, President) and assigns detailed portfolio responsibilities to the State Minister of Renewable Energy & Power, including specific functions (development of renewable power, solar projects, rural electrification, LNG/coal projects) and lists the departments, corporations, and laws under their purview. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it contains both "who" (government person/office) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities).
